💡 Medical Inflation & Protection Tip

With medical costs rising at 10%–14% annually in India, a basic ₹5 Lakh policy may not be enough for major treatments. Pair a Base Policy (₹5 Lakhs - ₹10 Lakhs) with a Super Top-Up (₹45 Lakhs - ₹90 Lakhs) for complete peace of mind.
